name: Menden (Sauerland, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Menden (Sauerland) (a white castle on black).
history: Municipal flag of Menden (Sauerland); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Menden arms — white castle on black
